text:
mari: quick sanity ping — onboarding 'sturgeon-3b' v1. weights uploaded but config.json gate failed in CI. can someone take a look?

ash: saw CI — lint error: missing "tokenizer.name" and seq_limit mismatch.

devon: where are the weights located? path and checksum pls.

ash: weights are at gs://redwood-models/sturgeon-3b/v1/weights.tar.gz (sha256: 9f2d...c3e)

ci-bot: config-lint reported 2 issues: 1) tokenizer.name missing 2) config.max_sequence default 2048 vs model expected 4096. full log: https://ci.redwood/rl/1234

mari: ah — tokenizer metadata was in README only. we need explicit tokenizer.name and special_tokens map. is tokenizer.vocab.bpe ok or do we need merges file?

ash: tokenizer uses byte-level BPE (vocab + merges). I'll add tokenizer.{"type":"bpe","vocab_uri":"gs://.../vocab.json","merges_uri":"gs://.../merges.txt"} and special_tokens_map.

devon: for seq limit, runtime expects max_seq 4096. can we add a "serving_defaults": {"max_sequence":4096} and also include "compat": ["runtime-v2"] so gate knows fallback?

mari: yes include serving_defaults. also add "quantization_profiles": [] with default profile name so Optimize can suggest later.

ash: small gotcha — our config-lint requires "tokenizer.special_tokens" to list at least "pad" and "eos" keys. the README had them as plain text. will convert to object.

ash: quick patch I'm about to push:
```json
{"tokenizer": {"type":"bpe","vocab_uri":"gs://redwood-models/sturgeon-3b/v1/vocab.json","merges_uri":"gs://redwood-models/sturgeon-3b/v1/merges.txt","special_tokens":{"pad":"<pad>","eos":"</s>","unk":"<unk>"}}, "serving_defaults": {"max_sequence":4096}}
```

mari: nice. please also add a small smoke test in ci: tools/run-smoke --model-config path/to/config.json --prompt "hello" to verify tokenizer loads.

ash: adding smoke test and unit test for tokenizer offset mapping. will open PR now -> https://git.redwood/p/sturgeon-onboard/pull/42 :thumbsup: 

ci-bot: PR build started. note: integration lint still flags missing "schema_version" field.

devon: add "schema_version": "2025-11-01". that's our current stable.

ash: done in PR. anything else?

mari: if PR passes i'll merge and kick a limited canary deploy to dedicated. @opsbot please schedule a 1-hour canary window tomorrow 09:30-10:30 PT.

opsbot: scheduled canary for sturgeon-3b v1 on dedicated pool "sturgeon-canary" — 2026-03-18 09:30 PT. Monitor: /d/s/sturgeon-canary

mari: thanks all. tagging doc task: devon can you add a one-liner in the model onboarding checklist about explicit tokenizer.* fields?

devon: on it, will add after merge.

ash: PR merged, CI green, smoke passed locally. assigning follow-ups in PR.

mari: perfect. closing loop — thanks team :tada:
